Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Prerequisite: Must have Hyperspeed

You have learned to create defensive constructs. When you use Light Constructs, you can instead create a Shield in a free hand or a flat 5 ft x 5 ft panel of light within 20 ft of you for 1 minute. The panel of light has an AC equal to your CE save DC, hit points equal to your level times your CE modifier, and immunity to radiant, poison, and psychic damage. You can choose to make it solid or not as a bonus action, allowing targets to move through it if non-solid.
